system.attitude: if your group faced a problem because you rushed into a situation without considering your allies, gain growth.
system.description:
You’re daring, but undisciplined and unpredictable, preferring to handle things your own way.

  • Attributes: Add +1 to Quickness and +1 to any other attribute

  • Skills: Add +1 to Fight or Operate.

  • Bonds: when you select bonds in the next step, at least one must be a supportive bond.

  • Drive: When the GM spends 3 or more Threat at once, regain 1 Spirit.

  • Exhaustion: Your dynamism comes to a quick halt when you find yourself out of your league. When you become exhausted, add +1 to Threat if you choose any exhaustion other than Breathless.

  • Attitude: if your group faced a problem because you rushed into a situation without considering your allies, gain growth.
